request.style: English, female solo voice, piano, acoustic guitar, strings, warm, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon
Eri, Arodi, and Areli
Sons of Gad in the line of Seth
Gathering near the river
Sixty-six in the house of Jacob
With Joseph’s two sons, the count was right
Seventy souls moving toward Egypt
Walking through the famine’s night

[Chorus]
Shuni’s name in the census book
The Shunite clan is counted true
East of the Jordan, land for flocks
Your inheritance is given to you

[Verse]
Reubenites and Gadites saw
Jazer and Gilead’s wide space
Ideal country for their herds
They stood before Moses’ face
Ataroth, Dibon, and Jazer
Nimrah, Heshbon, and Elealeh
Struck down before the community
Land for livestock, they pleaded

[Chorus]
Shuni’s name in the census book
The Shunite clan is counted true
East of the Jordan, land for flocks
Your inheritance is given to you

[Bridge]
Moses spoke of fathers’ sins
Who discouraged Israel’s heart
But they promised to go to war
And guard the little ones apart
Cross the Jordan for the LORD
Until the enemies fall
Then return to your possession
On the east side of all

[Outro]
The Shunite clan stands in the land
Inherited and free
